description: Response containing the transformed or generated creative manifest(s), ready for use with preview_creative or sync_creatives. Returns either a single creative_manifest, an array of creative_manifests (for multi-format requests), or error information.

oneOf.description: Single-format success response. Returned when the request used target_format_id.

creative_manifest.description: The generated or transformed creative manifest

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when generated asset URLs in the manifest expire. Set to the earliest expiration across all generated assets. Re-build the creative after this time to get fresh URLs.

preview.description: Preview renders included when the request set include_preview to true and the agent supports it. Contains the same content fields as a preview_creative single response (previews, interactive_url, expires_at) minus the response_type discriminator, so clients can reuse the same preview rendering logic.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when preview URLs expire. May differ from the manifest's expires_at.

interactive_url.description: Optional URL to an interactive testing page that shows all preview variants with controls to switch between them.

previews.description: Array of preview variants. Each preview corresponds to an input set from preview_inputs, or a single default preview if no inputs were provided.

input.description: The input parameters that generated this preview variant. Echoes back the request input or shows defaults used.

context_description.description: Context description applied to this variant

macros.description: Macro values applied to this variant

preview_id.description: Unique identifier for this preview variant

renders.description: Array of rendered pieces for this preview variant. Most formats render as a single piece. Companion ad formats render as multiple pieces.

preview_error.description: When include_preview was true in the request but preview generation failed. Uses the standard error structure with code, message, and recovery classification. Distinguishes 'agent does not support inline preview' (preview and preview_error both absent) from 'preview generation failed' (preview absent, preview_error present). Omitted when preview succeeded or was not requested.

sandbox.description: When true, this response contains simulated data from sandbox mode.

oneOf.title: BuildCreativeSuccess

oneOf.description: Multi-format success response. Returned when the request used target_format_ids. Contains one manifest per requested format. Multi-format requests are atomic — all formats must succeed or the entire request fails with an error response. Array order corresponds to the target_format_ids request order.

creative_manifests.description: Array of generated creative manifests, one per requested format. Each manifest contains its own format_id identifying which format it was generated for.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the earliest generated asset URL expires across all manifests. Re-build after this time to get fresh URLs.

preview.description: Preview renders included when the request set include_preview to true and the agent supports it. Contains one default preview per requested format. preview_inputs is ignored for multi-format requests.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when preview URLs expire. May differ from the manifest's expires_at.

interactive_url.description: Optional URL to an interactive testing page that shows all format previews with controls to switch between them.

previews.description: Array of preview entries, one per requested format. Array order matches creative_manifests. Each entry includes a format_id for explicit correlation.

format_id.description: The format this preview was generated for. Matches one of the requested target_format_ids.

input.description: The input parameters that generated this preview. For multi-format responses, this is always a default input.

context_description.description: Context description applied to this preview

macros.description: Macro values applied to this preview

renders.description: Array of rendered pieces for this format's preview. Most formats render as a single piece. Companion ad formats render as multiple pieces.

preview_error.description: When include_preview was true in the request but preview generation failed. Uses the standard error structure with code, message, and recovery classification. Omitted when preview succeeded or was not requested.

sandbox.description: When true, this response contains simulated data from sandbox mode.

oneOf.title: BuildCreativeMultiSuccess

errors.description: Array of errors explaining why creative generation failed
